﻿# Example override file for project-level or tenant-level UI customization.
# This file replaces or extends canonical pane coordinates and behavior.

ui_interface:
  ui_framework: multi_pane

  overrides:
    project: "project/ui/multi_pane.override.yaml"
    tenant: "tenant/ui/multi_pane.override.yaml"

  panes:
    - id: left
      role: tree
      coordinates:
        x: 0
        y: 0
        width: 35
        height: 100
      carousel:
        enabled: false

    - id: right
      role: preview
      coordinates:
        x: 35
        y: 0
        width: 65
        height: 100
      carousel:
        enabled: true
        navigation:
          wrap: true
          jump: true
          refresh: true
